summary: Sphere 3D Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. via a stock-for-stock arrangement under British Columbia law. The registrant, Sphere, acquired all Cathedra shares, making Cathedra a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction closed on June 1, 2026, under an arrangement agreement dated March 5, 2026. No deal terms (price, premium) or advisors are detailed in this filing. An employment agreement for CEO Joel Block was also entered. The deal is complete; watch for integration updates.
